modules.title: 修复一个未知原因的错误时，谁决定下一步
目标怎样经过行动与观察变成结果

items.title: 目标先确定边界
items.text: 用户说明要解决的问题、不可改动的范围和成功标准，运行时再把可用工具与当前环境交给模型。

items.title: 模型动态选择行动
items.text: 模型根据眼前信息决定先读哪个文件、运行哪项检查；工具返回的文件内容或测试结果会影响下一步。

items.title: 运行时控制继续与停止
items.text: 产品校验工具请求、记录进度，并在成功、失败、达到上限或需要人工判断时结束或暂停。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: “Agent”在不同产品里用法并不完全一致。判断时看模型是否会依据观察动态选择步骤，而不是只看产品名称；自主选择也不代表拥有无限权限，真实动作仍受工具、沙箱、确认和停止条件约束。

lessonPractice.title: 下面哪一种更符合 AI Agent，而不是单次回答或预先写死的工作流？

options.label: 它先读报错和相关文件，再根据测试结果自行决定继续定位、修改还是请求人工判断
options.feedback: 对。步骤不是预先固定的，模型会用环境中的真实观察决定下一步，同时仍受工具和停止条件控制。

options.label: 模型收到一篇文章，只返回一次摘要，不读取外部信息也不继续行动
options.feedback: 这是一次模型生成，没有围绕环境反馈反复选择行动。

options.label: 代码固定执行“分类、翻译、发送”三步，模型不能改变顺序或选择其他工具
options.feedback: 这是预设工作流：模型参与其中，但运行路径由代码提前决定。

en.title: Which example is best described as an AI agent rather than a single response or a predefined workflow?

options.label: It reads the error and relevant files, then uses test results to decide whether to investigate, edit, or ask for human judgment
options.feedback: Correct. The path is not fixed in advance: the model chooses actions from real observations while tools and stopping conditions still constrain it.

options.label: A model receives one article and returns one summary without external information or follow-up action
options.feedback: That is a single generation, not a loop of actions chosen from environmental feedback.

options.label: Code always runs classify, translate, and send in that order, and the model cannot change the path or choose another tool
options.feedback: That is a predefined workflow: a model participates, but code decides the route in advance.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 这个登录失败的原因还不清楚。请先读取报错和相关代码，再自己选择必要的检查；每次修改后运行对应测试。不要改登录以外的功能，也不要读取真实密钥。测试通过就停下并说明证据，遇到需要产品判断的地方先问我。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: The cause of this sign-in failure is unclear. Read the error and relevant code first, then choose the checks you need. Run the relevant test after each change. Do not alter unrelated features or read real secrets. Stop when tests pass and show the evidence; ask me before making a product decision.

learning.assumes: You have used a chat assistant or watched one read files and run checks.
learning.outcome: You can distinguish an agent’s model output from tool evidence and define a safe, checkable task for it.

modules.title: How an agent moves from a request to checked work
What makes an agent more than a chat reply

items.title: Set a goal and constraints
items.text: The product gives the agent a task, protected scope, and the information it needs.

items.title: Use permitted tools
items.text: The model can request reads, edits, or checks, but the runtime controls what it may do.

items.title: Report from evidence
items.text: Real tool results, file changes, and tests determine whether the task is actually complete.

modules.title: What people often confuse
modules.text: An agent is not automatically authorized or correct. Its permissions, tool results, and verification still determine what it can safely claim.

comparison.title: AI agent vs chatbot: what is the difference?
comparison.decision: A chatbot describes the conversational interface; an AI agent describes a goal-directed workflow that uses results to decide the next step. One product can be both.

dimensions.label: What it describes
dimensions.current: A workflow that takes actions, observes results, and continues toward a goal.
dimensions.other: An interface where people and an AI exchange messages.

dimensions.label: How work continues
dimensions.current: Uses tool output or other observations to choose another action or stop.
dimensions.other: Organizes interaction as turns; it may answer directly or provide access to an agent workflow.

dimensions.label: Typical workflow
dimensions.current: Inspects repository files, edits code, runs tests, and verifies fixes before concluding.
dimensions.other: Explains why an error occurred based on text pasted into the chat prompt.

scenario.title: Investigating an application bug
scenario.text: A chatbot can explain an error from the details you provide. An AI agent can take on the goal of fixing it: read files, edit code, run tests, and use the results to decide whether more work is needed. A chat interface may be how you control that agent.
